quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley reflects on the 2013 playoff collision with Russell Westbrook

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: We got OKC first round. Francisco Garcia was my vet. He said, 'You about to make your name. They going to remember you forever in these playoffs.' I got to feel that. Before the game, I'm putting on my jersey. I go, and coach put me in. I get some layups, a little float on. I got six, eight points. I'm feeling good. I'm playing, playoffs is up. Russ get the ball, and we it's competitive. Russ get the ball, he got that. He about to call timeout. But at the time, players don't call timeout. The coaches call it. And at the time, they had a play in OKC where they bring ball up the court. Fake it. He go and get monkey. I'm talking about, he in the lane like he go left, timeout.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: We fake it. We fake it. And we going and we going to run the plays back on when he did that a hundred times. We going to run the plays.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: So, so a lot of people don't understand that. I'm trying to do everything correct. I don't want to get hit with this and get put on film. That's my first year. In my mind, I'm thinking, man, if I make any mistakes, I'm out the league. These coaches, they go, man, I watch this man do this, left to right, boom, go dunk it. So he getting the ball, he going left to right. I try to go steal it. I clip him. I don't know what's going on. He finished game. He had like 29. He finished game. Everything cool we end up losing.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley recounts the aftermath of the Russell Westbrook injury
quotes.excerpt: I'm not even thinking, not one thought in my head is about I'm about to be blamed for this.
quotes.quote: We go back to Houston. Not the game one because the coach, Coach McHale, we were so close to OKC, the flight was easy. I walk in there, Coach McHale come to me, 'Hey, listen, just to let you know, Russell Westbrook, torn meniscus, he's out for the series.' I'm like, 'Oh shit, we got a chance to win.' I'm not even thinking, not one thought in my head is about I'm about to be blamed for this. Not one thought. Not one thought in my mind was like, you the reason this happened. The only thing I'm thinking is, we got a chance to win.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley describes security threats after the Westbrook injury
quotes.excerpt: Ball boy say, we go kill Patrick Beverley coming to OKC. People don't know that.
quotes.quote: I come in there, two police come next to me. I look at Coach McHale, he, 'Don't worry, everything's okay.' I, 'What's going on?' I, 'James, what's y'all room number?' We in eight something. I, 'Damn, why I'm only playing on number five?' I go to my room. It's two security guards outside my door. I, 'What the fuck is going on?' They done put hit out on me. Ball boy say, we go kill Patrick Beverley coming to OKC. People don't know that. They had to fire the ball boy. They be floating, they got a picture of him all around the thing. If y'all see him, yeah, all that. It's a real thing. Kill Patrick Beverley. They had to fire ball boy, all they got police next to my room and they got a police escort in my house in Houston and I'm in OKC.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley reflects on his career trajectory after the injury
quotes.excerpt: I went from that to, okay, I'm in the NBA now. I'm starting in the NBA now.
quotes.quote: That was my first NBA career. I'm broke, I ain't got none. I went from that to, okay, I'm in the NBA now. I went from that to, I'm starting in the NBA now. I went from that to public enemy number one in the world. You, injured Russell Westbrook, you fucked up our chance, OKC. We was supposed to be winning the championship and shouldn't have took shade to get our championship. We supposed to be running the championship, you fucked up.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley discusses his relationship with Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: I get the hit from Kobe, which I'm a free agent, what you doing? I was like, what's up?
quotes.quote: I get the hit from Kobe, which I'm a free agent, what you doing? I was like, what's up? He say, 'Let's go.' I already knew what that mean. I'm about to be like, all right, cool. I have my press conference. A motherfucker walk in, the coach hand, Russell Westbrook. I, damn. Mind you, we ain't spoke. We ain't, yeah, I'm sorry about that bullshit. None of that. Only time I seen Russ, shout out to Russ too because of this. Only time I seen Russ was that chapel at 60.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the NBA chapel tradition
quotes.excerpt: Russ ain't never missed a chapel. Those who don't know what chapel, we get a chance.
quotes.quote: Russ ain't never missed a chapel. Those who don't know what chapel, we get a chance before the game, 60 minutes on the clock, you get your mind right with God. You go get your mind right, go pray. They got a chapel in the past in there, he give you the word. Every every team has this. One of the greatest things I think the NBA has. So every time I see Russ, I see him in chapel. Whole time. We playing OKC or we playing any team you on, I don't even hit a word. I'm just looking at him.
